title: RecapIt AI launch
excerpt: I just launched RecapIt AI. The intelligent way to capture, analyze, and organize insights from short-form video content.
analysis: The post opens with an input to output line. That label comes from the post text, not from watching the video. Reported 351 views and 8 likes on the gallery listing, a like rate of 2.28 percent, above the library median of 0.56 percent. At 69 seconds it compares best with the 60 second structure.
